text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Sampling replicates spectra; overlapping replicas create aliasing

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Time panels show a2 Hz cosine. Frequency panels independently illustrate a triangular bandlimited spectrum with B=2 Hz; they are not the Fourier transform
of that cosine. Replica amplitudes are normalized, omitting the fs multiplier. At fs=3 Hz the2 Hz cosine aliases to1 Hz.
